Un déblocage ne se fait qu’une fois et u: An unlock only happens once and a purchase you need first is only paid for once; the time it takes to get it counts. “Lowest point” shows when you have the least money. If a must-have number is missing, the answer says “Path to complete” and tells you what to enter. If no plan keeps your money set aside, the plan is blocked and explains what to do: choose “As fast as possible” (the plan then dips into the money set aside and says so at every step) or change what you keep set aside. With no session duration, the path waits for the most profitable mission instead of starting just any mission, and it tells you if it leaves a mission out to go faster. The ammo you simulate in Expert mode is added to the fees of each attempt. Planned, started, and done are separate: “started” counts for nothing, only “done” (or a session you actually logged) changes the calculation, and the same session is never counted twice. When Rockstar publishes a mission’s conditions (money you must have on hand without spending it, a rank to reach, missions to do first), the plan will only start it once they’re met and will say what’s missing, for example “you still need $12,000 before you can start this mission”; a site mission taken into the plan comes with what it requires, and a mission you only do once stays in the plan, never in the eight calculations.
